scenes.title: 1: upfront disclosed?
scenes.note: three numbered pedestals rise in a row on 'signal comes'; the camera pushes in on pedestal 1 on 'First'; the '$ ?' upfront coin (S21 callback) falls onto it and squashes on 'discloses'; THE REAL PRICE OF ENTRY prints

scenes.title: 2: STP-100 Phase 1, early 2027
scenes.hero: pedestal 2: mini PHASE 1 gate with the STP-100 cart waiting
scenes.note: the camera trucks + cranes to pedestal 2 on 'Then'; a mini PHASE 1 gate rises on it with the STP-100 cart in front (S18 callback); EARLY 2027 drops onto the lintel; FIRST TIME IN PEOPLE prints

scenes.title: 3: first named program; a ceiling
scenes.hero: the red $5.9B plate hanging over the three pedestals
scenes.note: the camera whips to pedestal 3 on 'And then'; a shut '?' box drops onto it on 'first named'; on 'Until that' the camera pulls back to all three; the $5.9B plate drops onto its cables over them on '$5.9' (S1 callback); A CEILING, NOT A PAYMENT prints
